title_en: Great Poems and Songs (9/20): The Riddles of Li Shangyin
note_en: 在 before a verb marks an action in progress, like English "-ing": 学者们还在讨论 "scholars are still discussing." Paired with 还 ("still") it stresses that the action hasn't stopped. Unlike English, the verb itself never changes form; 在 alone does the work, while 了 would mark it as completed.

sentences.en: He has another poem called "The Ornate Zither," which opens: "For no reason the ornate zither has fifty strings; each string, each bridge, recalls my blossoming years."
